cover_headline: Harmeet Desai, Yashaswini Ghorpade End India's 72-Year Mixed Doubles Wait
facts: Harmeet Desai and Yashaswini Ghorpade won bronze in mixed doubles at the Asian Table Tennis Championships in Tashkent, India's first medal in the event in 72 years
The Indian pair beat South Korea's Park Ganghyeon and Lee Daeun 3-2 in the quarter-final, coming back from 1-2 down to win 11-6, 8-11, 8-11, 11-9, 11-9 in 42 minutes
India's previous mixed doubles medals at the championships were gold in 1952 and silver in 1954

end.headline: Harmeet Desai, Yashaswini Ghorpade End India's 72-Year Mixed Doubles Wait
end.line: The Indian pair beat South Korea in a five-game quarter-final in Tashkent and took bronze at the Asian Table Tennis Championships, India's first mixed doubles medal since 1954.
